Faculty responsibilities include, but are not limited to, teaching, conducting research, advising students, participating in conferences, and academic administration: The Assistant Professor will be responsible for designing and conducting research projects in the area of visual Communication, with a specific focus on digital design, visual ergonomics, and User Interfaces. This involves the responsibility of publishing scholarly articles in leading journals and conferences. The Assistant Professor will be responsible for teaching courses at the undergraduate and graduate levels that will involve preparing course materials, delivering lectures, and facilitating discussions that focus on their applications of visuals in digital systems, assessing student performance in projects, and providing feedback and mentoring to students on their use. Additionally, the Assistant Professor will mentor and advise undergraduate and graduate students, which will involve guiding research projects, career development opportunities in this field, and professional networking with experts in these areas. The Assistant Professor will be expected to participate in various academic and administrative activities of the department, such as attending meetings, serving on committees, and contributing to the development of the curriculum and research agenda of the department. The Assistant Professor will be responsible for engaging with industry and other external partners to promote research and innovation in Visual Communication. ﻿ Qualifications: A Ph.D. (awarded or nearing submission) in Visual Communication or a related field Demonstrated expertise and research experience in Visual Communication Strong teaching skills and a commitment to excellence in education Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills Evidence of scholarly achievement, including publications and grants ﻿ We offer a competitive salary, a benefits package, and a supportive and collaborative work environment. If you are passionate about Visual communication research and education and are looking for a challenging and rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your CV and a cover letter. ads.title: Assistant Professor in Human-Computer Interaction
ads.raw_text_excerpt: We are inviting applications for the position of full-time Assistant Professor in Human-Computer Interaction. Faculty responsibilities include, but are not limited to, teaching, conducting research, advising students, participating in conferences, and academic administration: The Assistant Professor will be responsible for designing and conducting research projects in the area of HCI, with a specific focus on AR/VR, electronics, and embedded systems. This involves the responsibility of publishing scholarly articles in leading journals and conferences. The Assistant Professor will be responsible for teaching courses at the undergraduate and graduate levels related to HCI that will involve preparing course materials that incorporate these technologies, delivering lectures and facilitating discussions that focus on their application in interactive systems, assessing student performance in projects that involve these technologies, and providing feedback and mentoring to students on their use. Additionally, the Assistant Professor will mentor and advise undergraduate and graduate students in HCI. This will involve guiding research projects that use these technologies, career development opportunities in this field, and professional networking with experts in these areas. The Assistant Professor will be expected to participate in various academic and administrative activities of the department, such as attending meetings, serving on committees, and contributing to the development of the curriculum and research agenda of the department. The Assistant Professor will be responsible for engaging with industry and other external partners to promote research and innovation in the area of HCI. Qualifications: A Ph.D. (awarded or nearing submission) in Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field Demonstrated expertise and research experience in HCI Strong teaching skills and a commitment to excellence in education Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills Evidence of scholarly achievement, including publications and grants We offer a competitive salary, a benefits package, and a supportive and collaborative work environment. If you are passionate about HCI research and education and are looking for a challenging and rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your CV and a cover letter. FLAME values talented scholars

ads.title: Assistant Professor in History
ads.raw_text_excerpt: We are inviting applications from highly research-active candidates for the positions of full-time Assistant Professor in History. While we welcome applicants from any area of history, we are particularly interested in applicants with an expertise in areas such as Medieval and/or Early Modern South Asian History, Ancient South Asian History and History of South Asia and the World. Faculty responsibilities include but are not limited to teaching, advising students, participating in faculty colloquia, and academic administration. Over the years, the department has engaged with a large number of organizations including NAL, GTRE, HAL, DRDL, ADE, ARDE, ADA, ADRDE, ISRO, IAF, USAF, BARC, Boeing, Pratt and Whitney, Airbus and GE for scientific and engineering research. The department seeks applications from dynamic and motivated candidates with excellent academic record along with specialization in the any of the following domains: Dynamics, vibration and Structural Acoustics, Aeroelasticity, Multifunctional materials and structures, Structural integrity, Structural health monitoring, Stealth technology, Vehicle and systems design, Flexible structures, Materials for extreme environment, Rocket and spacecraft propulsion, Turbomachinery, Propellants and explosives, Autonomy and control, Space situational awareness, Aircraft Design, Systems Engineering, Drone aerodynamics, Rotary wing vehicles, Hypersonics and high speed flows, Missile aerodynamics; It is strongly desirable that at least one of the degrees should be in Aerospace/Aeronautical engineering. ads.raw_text_excerpt: Biological Sciences and Bioengineering (BSBE) is a multi-disciplinary department addressing both basic and applied areas of Life Sciences and Bioengineering. Research in BSBE is focused on: regenerative medicine (stem cell biology, tissue engineering, drug delivery, biomedical device); understanding protein structure-function relationship (structural and computational biology); engineering approaches to understanding biological systems (biomechanics, image processing, electrophysiology, computational modeling), cellular, molecular, developmental, and neuro-biology addressing fundamental aspects of cell differentiation and growth; disease models - animal models for human diseases. Applications for faculty positions in the following areas are invited: Systems Biology Biochemical Engineering Applicants are expected to organize and participate in multi-disciplinary research and contribute to teaching both at the undergraduate and graduate levels. ads.title: Faculty — Earth Sciences
ads.raw_text_excerpt: The Department of Earth Sciences at the IIT Kanpur invites applications for faculty positions from outstanding candidates with demonstrated excellence in research and teaching. We seek highly motivated individuals who can contribute to cutting-edge research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and high-quality education in Earth Sciences. Applications are particularly encouraged from candidates with expertise in one or more of the following areas: Process-Based Geochemistry We seek candidates whose research focuses on fundamental geochemical processes governing fluid-rock interactions, mass transfer, reaction pathways, and element mobility across Earth systems. Research areas may include hydrothermal systems, critical mineral formation, rare earth elements (REEs), ore-forming processes, and geochemical cycling. Candidates with interests relevant to resource sustainability, critical minerals, and energy-transition materials are particularly encouraged to apply. Experimental Solid Earth Processes Candidates with expertise in experimental petrology, mineral physics, rock deformation, and high-pressure-high-temperature Earth and planetary processes are encouraged to apply. Research may address the mechanical, thermal, and chemical behaviour of Earth materials across a wide range of crustal, mantle, and planetary environments. The successful candidate will contribute to advancing the existing experimental geosciences through innovative laboratory-based research and interdisciplinary collaborations. Energy Geoscience Applications are invited from researchers working on subsurface processes related to conventional and emerging energy systems. Relevant areas include petroleum systems, geothermal resources, carbon capture and storage (CCS), subsurface energy storage, basin evolution, reservoir characterization, and fluid-flow processes in the Earth's crust. Candidates employing quantitative, process-based, or multidisciplinary approaches are particularly encouraged. Natural Hazards We seek candidates working on the processes, monitoring, forecasting, and mitigation of natural hazards, including earthquakes, landslides, floods, and related geohazards. Research integrating field observations, geophysical measurements, remote sensing, modelling, data analytics, or risk assessment is highly desirable. Successful candidates will contribute to both fundamental understanding and societally relevant solutions for hazard resilience and disaster risk reduction. Sedimentology and Palaeontology Applications are invited from candidates specializing in sedimentology, stratigraphy, palaeontology, basin analysis, biogeology, paleoenvironmental reconstruction, or related fields. The Department seeks to strengthen its capabilities in sedimentary Earth systems while expanding educational and research opportunities in palaeontology and Earth history. Candidates with quantitative and interdisciplinary approaches are especially encouraged. Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science for Earth Systems We seek researchers developing and applying advanced computational, AI/ML, and data science approaches to address challenges in Earth and environmental sciences. Potential areas include geospatial analytics, climate and environmental modelling, geophysical inversion, remote sensing, Earth observation, geochemical data analysis, digital Earth systems, and predictive modelling. Candidates whose research bridges geosciences with modern computational methods are particularly welcome. The Department values interdisciplinary research and encourages applications from candidates whose work spans traditional disciplinary boundaries. Successful candidates are expected to establish internationally recognized research programs, attract external funding, mentor students, and contribute effectively to undergraduate and graduate teaching. For information about the Department of Earth Sciences, IIT Kanpur, please visit: https://www.iitk.ac.in/es/ . Professor…

ads.title: Chair Professor in Economics
ads.raw_text_excerpt: We are inviting applications for Chair Professor in Economics. While we welcome applicants from any area of Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Econometrics, International Economics, Development Economics or any other applied areas in the field, we are particularly interested in applicants with an expertise in theoretical and applied economics. Endowed Chair Professorships have been instituted in the thrust areas of the University through generous contributions from philanthropists and industry. With a Ph.D. in relevant area and minimum 15 years of teaching/research/industrial experience, the Chair professor will be a well-known and accomplished scholar and researcher in the field. The endowment for the chair professor shall cover the following: Excellent compensation and benefits for the Chair Professor Support for hiring Research Assistants/Associates/Consultants to assist in research activities. Research and travel funds for conducting research, outreach, and networking. Student support to encourage the chair professor to mentor and support student research projects and other educational activities. Engagement with the public for promoting and disseminating their work. Computational facilities, books, and equipment for conducting research. The appointment will be for 3 years which is extendable on mutual agreement.

ads.title: Professor in Business Analytics & Operations
ads.raw_text_excerpt: We are inviting applications from highly research-active candidates for the position of full-time Professor in Business Analytics & Operations. Faculty responsibilities include, but are not limited to, teaching, conducting research, advising students, participating in conferences, and academic administration. A successful applicant is expected to: Undertake independent high-quality research as well as work actively with existing members to deliver innovation in research and teaching Remain committed to excellence in teaching - a core value of FLAME University- and adopt creative pedagogies that foster a learning environment Work in collaboration with colleagues with an open and inclusive mindset We are particularly interested in applicants with expertise in the following areas: Business Analytics: Decision Sciences/Quantitative Techniques, Data Mining, Data Visualization, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Commerce, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing. Operations: Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Project Management, Lean Management, Internet of Things, and Industry 4.0. A Ph.D. (awarded or nearing submission) in any of the disciplines listed above is a minimum requirement. How to apply: Please apply through the FLAME University portal: https://jobs.flame.edu.in/ against the relevant position. The application must include: Cover letter A detailed curriculum vitae A statement of your teaching philosophy A research statement, including a list of papers in the pipeline Copies of recent publications (research papers/case studies published in peer-reviewed journals, chapters etc.) Two letters of recommendation/contact details of two referees Review of applications will commence immediately. The recruitment process is multi-staged involving job talk and interviews. FLAME values talented scholars and offers a competitive salary and a generous benefits package including subsidies towards costs of housing, retirement benefits, as well as conference/research grants. For all enquiries, email us at careers@flame.edu.in
